description: This file declares the DobbyEventListener class and its nested OCIContainerNotification class, which implement event handling and notification mechanisms for container lifecycle events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes interface references, class definitions, and method declarations related to container event notifications.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing container event notifications and interactions with the plugin host and event handler.

classes.name: OCIContainerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the INotification interface to handle container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state change.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the event listener with the plugin service, event handler, and OCI container object.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the event listener, cleaning up resources.
